title: VP, Supply Chain Applications and Digital Solutions, North America Foods and Beverages
personalisation_hook: He shared an NRF 2026 stage with NVIDIA on AI in supply chain, while the applications estate he owns still requires eight years of Blue Yonder/JDA TMS experience to run.
recommended_opening_line: You were on the NRF 2026 panel with NVIDIA on AI in supply chain, and PepsiCo's current transportation req still asks for eight years of Blue Yonder TMS - that gap between the panel and the platform is what I work on.

title: Vice President, Supply Chain Analytics
personalisation_hook: He personally fronted Loblaw's Blue Yonder demand planning case study and then spoke on a Schulich panel about where AI creates value in supply chain work today.
recommended_opening_line: You fronted Loblaw's Blue Yonder demand planning case study and then told the Schulich panel where AI actually creates value in supply chain work - I'd like to test one claim of mine against that view.

title: Director, Supply Chain Systems & Analytics
personalisation_hook: She is a named contributor to a Kinaxis life-sciences guide and carries the 'formerly Seagen' systems context - she is living the acquisition-integration problem in the systems layer.
recommended_opening_line: Kinaxis credited you in their life sciences guide as 'formerly Seagen' - which means you're one of the few people who has had to reconcile a Kinaxis-and-Oracle estate with Pfizer's, and I suspect transport execution was the messiest part.

title: Senior Vice President Supply Chain
personalisation_hook: She gave Supply Chain Dive an on-record interview in February 2026 and speaks at the American Supply Chain Summit - she is accessible and has a field supply chain remit, which is where TMS pain is felt.
recommended_opening_line: You lead field supply chain at PepsiCo, where the transportation stack still runs on Blue Yonder TMS - PepsiCo's own open req asks for eight years on it - and field is where that shows up first.

title: Vice President, Distribution Center Operations
personalisation_hook: He publicly said on Zero100's site that he 'loved the many presentations around AI' and left with 'actionable items I can implement with the team' - a named executive who has already declared AI interest in writing.
recommended_opening_line: You told Zero100 you left their event with 'actionable items I can implement with the team' after the AI sessions - across ten CVS DCs the most actionable AI usually turns out to sit at the dock, not in the building.

title: Director, SAP & Supply Chain Systems, Loblaw Technology & Analytics
personalisation_hook: She won a 2025 Star Women in Grocery award as a Senior Manager and has since been promoted to Director of SAP & Supply Chain Systems - a newly-empowered hands-on systems owner.
recommended_opening_line: You picked up a 2025 Star Women in Grocery award as a senior manager and now own SAP and supply chain systems as a director - which puts you directly between Loblaw's Blue Yonder planning estate and 50 Gatik autonomous trucks.

title: VP Supply Chain Strategy & Product Flow
personalisation_hook: His remit is literally 'product flow', and CVS's own job spec shows that flow crossing Manhattan Active, Blue Yonder, Infor, SAP SCM, MercuryGate and Omnitracs.
recommended_opening_line: CVS's open Lead Director, Supply Chain Systems req lists Manhattan Active, Blue Yonder, Infor, SAP SCM, MercuryGate and Omnitracs - six systems for the product flow you own.

title: Sr Director Supply Chain Strategy & Network Design
personalisation_hook: Network design is the one function where a 15% SKU cut and a RELEX replenishment rollout landing in early 2027 both have to be modelled at once.
recommended_opening_line: Lowe's is cutting roughly 15% of SKUs while RELEX rewires forecasting, replenishment and allocation for early 2027 - both land on the network design you own, and transport is usually the constraint neither model accounts for.

title: Senior Director, Supply Chain Optimization
personalisation_hook: Dollar General told Manifest 2026 it had improved inbound appointment scheduling and segmented storebound orders - and it is hiring a TMS implementation analyst right now.
recommended_opening_line: Dollar General described improved inbound appointment scheduling and segmented storebound orders at Manifest this February, and is now hiring a TMS implementation analyst in Goodlettsville - I wanted to ask which of those two is actually the constraint.

title: Supply Chain Transformation Director
personalisation_hook: His job title is literally the programme - 'Supply Chain Transformation' - inside a PepsiCo transformation that publicly still runs Blue Yonder/JDA TMS.
recommended_opening_line: Your title is the programme itself, and PepsiCo's current transportation req still asks for eight years of Blue Yonder TMS experience - formerly JDA - which is usually the last thing a transformation gets to.

title: Vice President, Supply Chain Distribution Operations (NOT Chief Supply Chain Officer)
personalisation_hook: He runs Lowe's DC operations while RELEX rewires replenishment and allocation above him for early 2027.
recommended_opening_line: Lowe's is putting RELEX across forecasting, replenishment and allocation by early 2027 - which changes what the distribution operations you run are actually asked to execute against.
